segments.narration: One prototype prompt. Four distinct UIs to compare. NEEF makes the options visible before you choose what to build.
Choose a direction. Refine it with feedback.
Execute the chosen direction. NEEF carries the approved design into a working app.
Evaluate the result. Check the build, then prove the exported CSS works in another interface.
Follow up with another prototype. Add typography. Compare three font pairings before choosing one.
Apply the choice. Navigate, execute, evaluate, follow up. That is NEEF: an idea carried through.
